# 🟢 Dragon Ball Z Totem – Master Roshi

Bring the humor and wisdom of Master Roshi into your Minecraft survival.
This resource pack transforms the **Totem of Undying** into a custom pixel-art design of the legendary Turtle Hermit. Quirky yet iconic, Roshi’s totem form will keep you alive with style when danger strikes.

---

✨ **Current Characters Available:**  

- **Goku Totem** [Download Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-undying-goku)
- **Vegeta Totem** [Download Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-undying-vegeta)
- **Gohan Totem** [Download Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-undying-gohan)
- **Picolo Totem** [Download Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-undying-picolo)
- **Frieza Totem** [Download Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-undying-frieza)
- **Roshi Totem** [Download Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-undying-roshi)  

---

✨ **Features**

- Custom Totem of Undying texture – Master Roshi
- Vanilla-friendly, no OptiFine required
- Compatible across Minecraft **1.8 → 1.21+**
- Lightweight & safe for multiplayer use
- Perfect for Dragon Ball fans who love nostalgic characters

---

📥 **Installation**

1. Download the `.zip` file.
2. Drop it into your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder.
3. Enable in-game under Resource Packs.
